description:
List the custom message templates of one sub-account (project), organized by channel and message type. Templates belong to a project, not to the account: profile_id picks it — omitted, a project-bound key lists its own project and an account-wide key the primary project.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.

profile_id.description: The sub-account (project) to act on; omitted → your key's project, or the primary project for an account-wide key

name: list_templates
